brief:
With Israel's election producing no clear winner, President Donald Trump confronts prolonged uncertainty over leadership of Washington's closest Middle East ally, Al-Monitor reported. The deadlocked vote complicates Trump's ability to coordinate policy with Israel as he addresses challenges from Iran and Gaza.

The outcome leaves the U.S. president without a definitive Israeli partner for critical regional diplomacy during a period of heightened tensions and active conflict.
dek: By Matt Spetalnick WASHINGTON, Oct 28 (Reuters) - With Israel's election yielding no clear winner, President Donald Trump could face prolonged uncertainty over who will lead Washington's closest Middle East ally as he confronts challenges from Iran and Gaza…
title: Trump faces uncertainty as Israel's election deadlocks
